description: This file defines a React component 'CompanyShow' which renders a detailed view of a company entity within a React-Admin based application. It includes subcomponents for displaying company details, contacts, deals, activity logs, and related actions, utilizing Material-UI components, react-admin hooks, and routing.

methods.name: CompanyShow
methods.description: Main component exporting the detailed view of a company, encapsulating 'CompanyShowContent'.

methods.name: CompanyShowContent
methods.description: Subcomponent that retrieves and displays detailed information about a specific company, including activity logs, contacts, and deals, with conditional rendering based on data availability.

methods.name: ContactsIterator
methods.description: Renders a list of contacts associated with the company, displaying their names, titles, last activity, and a link to their detail view.

methods.name: CreateRelatedContactButton
methods.description: Button component to create a new contact related to the current company, passing the company ID in the routing state.

methods.name: DealsIterator
methods.description: Displays a list of deals associated with the company, including deal name, stage, amount, category, and last activity date.
